widget_mechanic: After applying ≥2 filters, an active-chip bar shows what is currently applied. Agent must verify each required chip is present (and no extras) before treating the result set as the answer.

source_inspiration.instruction: Find a condo for rent in Houston, TX, with a monthly rent of no more than 30% of an income (e.g. monthly $2,000 cap).
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: Agent set the home-type filter to “Condo” but the applied-filter pill bar across the top still showed conflicting Home Type / Specialty Housing chips from a prior search; agent never removed the stale chip via its ×.
